other_conditions: Applicant must provide true information and declare it as such
Applicant must furnish any clarifications or further details requested by the recommending/sanctioning authority
Applicant must allow inspection or verification of tools, equipment, accessories, and other assets if required
Applicant must produce originals of any important documents if requested for verification
Applicant must execute the requisite legal agreement on paper when the proposal is approved
Applicant must utilize the received amount only as agreed upon
Applicant must operate the unit as stipulated in the agreement; otherwise assistance may be recovered under the Kerala Revenue Recovery Act
Eligibility category noted in source: Women
Eligibility category noted in source: SC/ST
Eligibility category noted in source: Young (18-45)
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time grant of up to ₹2 lakh (40 % of fixed capital) for general artisans and up to ₹3 lakh (50 % of fixed capital) for women, young (18‑45) and SC/ST artisans to set up handicraft enterprises.
